correction.attribution: Parent handoff of bounded independent scout-port readonly audit, plus Lead bounded decoding of recorded frame metadata; scout audit is NOT final review or QA.
correction.observed: All62 timed marker frames are agent_events batches with message_start containing complete ALPHA_OMEGA, message_end, turn_end, run_end, submission, usage_changed. PTY observations are complete-answer bytes, not parsed terminal/render/paint or true first-token measurements.
correction.order: Always reference FIRST within every warm pair; fixed AB order is NOT counterbalanced or randomized and confounds comparison.
correction.cold: Fresh process/session only; OS page cache was NOT flushed. Attach is observed after socket readiness, not full process startup.
correction.implementation: BOTH sides execute SAME candidates/host source. Reference original-parent managed loader versus candidate adjusted-location managed loader; no distinct new implementation, SDK migration or speedup proved.
correction.workloadBinding: 62 timed rows/63 observed HTTP requests; extra candidate index31 held diagnostic is untimed. Message hashes joined by (side,index) within this run; NOT self-contained authenticated row/request receipts.
correction.guardScope: Real adaptExtensionTool with synthetic Boolean policy only. Counter0 on denied fixture/control1 does NOT prove actual MCP or Agent Mail authorization.
correction.comparison: INCONCLUSIVE: no independent limiter profile, fixed-order confound, same host implementation, run-local workload joins; no first-incremental-text or paint metric.

fixtureExceptions.scope: HTTP fixture exceptions ONLY, NOT all protocol/runtime errors

recordedProtocolResponses.expectedFailure: Shared host belongs to a different working directory
